coverage: The index loads all four missions from the byte-identical LOCK 90 V1 file.

The live Chapter 1 ending unlocks the house at the quay from 08:00 through 17:59. One coin short hides the purchase. Not now and purchase show their exact endings and complete on Back. Buying costs 300 coins and saves ownership.

House ownership unlocks free sleep at the quay from 19:00 through 04:29. An expired choice cannot act. Sleep before or after midnight wakes at the next 04:40 and saves the opening evening as the completed day. Reload preserves the once-per-night allowance.

The live Road map reaches Tinara and its live story sets tinara_done. Tinara's orchard offer opens from 07:00 through 16:59. Not now keeps it open. Buying costs exactly 150 coins and saves ownership and completion.

The harvest opens on day 30 from purchase, then at 30-day intervals measured from the last collection. Gleaning adds 25 coins and 20 meals to the existing Journal goal; selling adds 30 coins. Neither creates Journal mission rows. Reload preserves the orchard timer and meal total.
The purchase, sleep and harvest choices use locked wording and order. No LOCK 90 choice changes trust or adds local sayings.
visual_reference: Approved oc01–oc06 are 1920 × 1080. Q15 and Q49 Layout B (R11) use the existing Godot layout with headless rules checks. The masters establish the words and order.
